reference: FCDB-train (1369) + GAICD-train (1000) = 2369 training images; one reference crop per image = its K=10 candidate with the highest IoU to the human ground-truth crop (a near-human-framing proxy; ground-truth crops themselves carry no candidate features). Test images never enter this calibration.
quantity: per-token absolute (non-contrastive, vs the model base value) SHAP contribution from the release ranker's exact decomposition; the sign is retained, so a token that pulls the score down maps to a low gauge.
